transaction: synchronous MainOperation; IsInTransaction must be true; initiating caller only
numberSource: Existing regional Dataverse AutoNumber; never client arithmetic

apis.name: gr_RegisterJobBookJob
apis.privilegeGate: Resolve ExecutePrivilegeName from published metadata during approved preflight; require caller regional Create plus Job Create/Write privileges. Never leave ExecutePrivilegeName empty.

apis.name: gr_AllocateJobBookNumber
apis.privilegeGate: Resolve ExecutePrivilegeName from published metadata and verify only coordinators hold this privilege. If Admin also holds it, STOP and choose a reviewed existing coordinator-only privilege; do not silently broaden authorization.

parameters.ExpectedRowVersion: String required, numeric exact SDK RowVersion

apis.name: gr_ManageJobBookJob
apis.privilegeGate: Use the same reviewed coordinator-only ExecutePrivilegeName as number allocation. FullAccess and ServiceCoordinator only; Admin roles must not hold it.

parameters.ExpectedJobRowVersion: String required, numeric exact SDK RowVersion

apis.name: gr_VoidRegisteredJobBookEntry
apis.privilegeGate: Resolve a reviewed privilege held by FullAccess, ServiceCoordinator, OfficeAdmin and JobBookAdmin only. The plugin, invariant guard and restricted-access guard must be deployed together.

parameters.ExpectedJobRowVersion: String required, numeric exact SDK RowVersion
parameters.ExpectedLedgerRowVersion: String required, numeric exact SDK RowVersion

apis.name: gr_QueueInitialJobDispatch
apis.privilegeGate: FullAccess, ServiceCoordinator and OfficeAdmin only. JobBookAdmin must not hold the ExecutePrivilegeName. Generic Email Dispatch Create remains blocked by the restricted-access guard.

parameters.RequestId: Guid required and retained for retry
parameters.ExpectedJobRowVersion: String required, numeric exact SDK RowVersion
parameters.RecipientEmail: String required, max 320; must equal the current assigned technician
parameters.Subject: String required, max 500

apis.boundary: The Azure submission-link service remains separate. The client must finish link generation and render the bounded message before calling this API; retries must reuse the identical RequestId and body.

gr_job.gr_coordinatormanaged: Boolean; new registration explicitly false; existing records require reviewed migration and legacy fallback
gr_job.gr_registrationvoid: Boolean; set only by the atomic registered-entry Void API
gr_job.gr_registrationvoidreason: String max 1000; set with gr_registrationvoid by the same transaction

gr_emaildispatch.gr_jobdispatchfingerprint: String max 64; canonical SHA-256 replay identity for guarded initial dispatch

regionalColumns.gr_registeredjob: Optional Lookup to gr_job; independent of historical gr_promotedjob
regionalColumns.gr_registrationfingerprint: Optional String max 64; canonical SHA-256 replay identity

requiredExistingMetadata: active unique gr_jobnumber key on gr_job
active unique gr_jobnumber key on each regional ledger
regional AutoNumbers configured and approved cutover seeds set
gr_job.gr_jobtype accepts no value without defaulting to an operational type
all referenced lookup logical names and caller privileges verified

invariantPlugin.updateFilteringAttributes: NONE: protect ledger snapshots as well as number writes
invariantPlugin.gate: Do not register until imports/migration and every creation/allocation/deletion caller including WOF/Site Checks have switched to reviewed workflows. It intentionally blocks legacy manual numbering and registered-ledger edits except the exact atomic registered-entry Void child update. Verify Custom API parent-context behavior, cascading deletes and privilege-bypass permissions in approved environment tests.

releaseGates: signed assembly packaging and Custom API/step registration
server-side Admin field authorization including target-environment verification of the linked Void child writes
production approvals and target-user security tests
